services.desc: The Blinn College District health clinics provide excellent minor ambulatory health care in an academic environment and in collaboration with other departments to promote healthy lifestyles. Through health promotion, educational programs, and accessible health care services, we promote a healthy community to enhance student success. Blinn has partnered with Baylor Scott & White Health at the Brenham, Bryan, and RELLIS campuses to provide free on-campus health services for all current Blinn students throughout the College District, including online students.
